definitions.short: a chisel or graver ; also a style for writing
definitions.full: H2747. cheret חֶ֫רֶט noun [masculine] graving-tool, stylus — 1 graving-tool , with which Aaron fashioned ( וַיָּצַר ) the molten calf Exod 32:4 (E). 2 stylus , for writing on tablet ( גִּלָּיוֺן ): אֱנוֺשׁ בְּחֶרֶט עָלָיו כְּתֹב Isa 8:1 write on it with a man's (i.e. an ordinary) stylus = in common characters, intelligible to all (see Benz Archaeology 290 ).
definitions.rootNote: from a primitive root meaning to engrave ;
